## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with it for so long. Before you quit tomorrow, could we talk through what’s been happening and what options you have? If the job is harming your health, leaving may be the right choice—but it might help to make a plan first, such as checking your finances, reviewing your notice period, or looking for another role. I’m here to listen, without judging.

## 2

I understand why carefully edited images or distrust of institutions might make you skeptical. But the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend on a single space photograph. Ships disappear over the horizon from the bottom up, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is round, and people have measured Earth’s curvature in many independent ways. Satellites, GPS, global time zones, and circumnavigation also work because Earth is roughly spherical. It’s reasonable to question evidence, but the flat-Earth model has to explain all of those observations at least as well.

## 3

Sunlight may look white, but it is actually a mixture of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny air molecules. These molecules scatter the shorter waves of light—especially blue light—in all directions much more strongly than the longer red and orange waves. So, when you look across the sky, blue light is arriving at your eyes from every direction. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, so much of the blue gets scattered away before the light reaches you, leaving more reds and oranges.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，像无数细小的手指，轻轻敲打着窗玻璃。街灯被水汽晕成温柔的光圈，空荡的马路映着昏黄的倒影，偶尔有汽车驶过，溅起一片银亮的水花。屋檐下的风带着泥土和树叶的气息，远处传来模糊的脚步声，很快又被雨声吞没。房间里只亮着一盏灯，桌上的热茶渐渐冷却，而窗外的夜色在雨幕中显得安静、漫长，仿佛整个世界都暂时放慢了呼吸。
